request.style: English, Motown soul, female lead vocal with girl-group backing harmonies, bass groove, tambourine, electric piano, horns, strings, lively, 116 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Ten young girls with their lamps all ready
Waiting for the wedding night
Five of them were foolish, five of them were wise
Five brought oil to keep their lamps alight

[Verse]
The bridegroom was a long time in coming
So they all grew drowsy and fell asleep
But at midnight there came a shout
And the wise ones had their oil to keep

[Chorus]
Here is the bridegroom
Come out to meet him
Keep your lamp burning
Keep watch, keep watch

[Verse]
Give us some of your oil, our lamps are going out
The foolish ones cried, but the wise ones said no
While they were away the bridegroom came
And the door was shut, and they had nowhere to go

[Chorus]
Here is the bridegroom
Come out to meet him
Keep your lamp burning
Keep watch, keep watch

[Bridge]
So keep watch
Because you do not know the day or the hour
Keep watch
Because you do not know the day or the hour

[Outro]
Here is the bridegroom
Come out to meet him
